description: Unified external horizontal experiment for ReAct-style, ToT-style, and Reflexion-style baselines under the frozen issue199 fairness contract and issue209 task set.

tool_whitelist.enforcement_rule: External baseline runs must stay within the same allowlist and carry the whitelist version into every normalized artifact.

high_cost_rules.rationale: Structure prediction calls consume the main high-cost model budget.

high_cost_rules.rationale: Iterative backbone-conditioned sequence refinement is expensive and recovery-heavy.

high_cost_rules.label: 重型目标评估
high_cost_rules.rationale: Heavy multi-objective scoring or remote property evaluation adds significant evaluation cost.

primary.install_hint: uv tool run --from 'inspect-ai[openai]' inspect info version

external_baseline.notes: Issue #199 only prepares the adapter package and reproducibility bundle.

tasks.prompt: Design a compact enzyme-like fold with stable core.
